requirements.title: ACOS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: X shall be real with |X| <= 1, or complex.

pending.acos-argument-admissible: Future positive controls call ACOS with admissible argument types and values from p3. Invalid type or out-of-domain source shapes remain source-control only and carry no local diagnostic expectation because p3 is an unnumbered argument restriction.

requirements.title: ACOS result characteristics match X
requirements.definition: The ACOS result has the same characteristics as X.

pending.acos-result-characteristics-same-as-x: Future fixture calls ACOS on a nondefault admissible X of a selected kind and asserts the result kind matches X using KIND inquiry or type-compatible assignment, without relying on an exact rounded mathematical value.

requirements.title: ACOS mathematical approximation is processor dependent
requirements.source: 16.9.4 p5 approximation clause; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF377.
requirements.definition: The ACOS result value is a processor-dependent approximation to the specified inverse cosine function.

pending.acos-processor-dependent-approximation: No portable oracle may require a particular rounded floating result for the approximation. Future tests may assert only source-fixed bounds or exact characteristics, not exact transcendent values.

requirements.title: ACOS result range constraints
requirements.source: 16.9.4 p5 range clause; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF377.
requirements.definition: The result is constrained by the real or complex-part ranges stated in p5.

pending.acos-real-result-radians-range: Future fixture uses admissible real inputs such as -1.0, 0.0, and 1.0 initialized through nondefault variables and asserts the returned value lies between 0 and ACOS(-1.0) or another source-derived pi bound without exact equality.
pending.acos-complex-real-part-radians-range: Future fixture uses admissible complex controls and asserts REAL(ACOS(X)) lies within the p5 bounds, not a particular rounded complex value.

accounting.rationale: Description identifies ACOS; value requirements are in p5.
Classifies ACOS as elemental; elemental obligations are owned elsewhere.
Mixed processor-dependent approximation latitude and exact range constraints are split.
Exact stated range bounds on the result or result part.
Example is illustrative and approximate; no requirement is based on it.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9 and 16.9.1-16.9.7: ABS, ACHAR, ACOS, ACOSD, ACOSH and ACOSPI (batch179). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer, accepted with no findings. ACHAR's required results for codes 0-127 are split from the processor-dependent cases, and the exact result ranges of the inverse cosine family are split from their processor-dependent approximations; Examples are informative. Source accounting only.
